{{short description|French cryptographer}}
'''David Pointcheval''' is a French cryptographer. He is currently the Chief scientific officer (CSO) of Cosmian (on leave from CNRS), a French deeptech company in public cloud security.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://cosmian.com/david-pointcheval-joins-cosmian-as-chief-scientific-officer/|title=David Pointcheval Joins Cosmian as Chief Scientific Officer|website=Cosmian|access-date=30 May 2025}}</ref> He is a Senior Researcher at CNRS, and the former head of the Computer Science Department and Cryptography Laboratory at the [[École normale supérieure]].
He is mainly known for his contributions in the area of provable security, including the [[Forking lemma]],<ref>{{Cite journal|url=https://link.springer.com/content/pdf/10.1007/s001450010003.pdf|doi=10.1007/s001450010003|title=Security Arguments for Digital Signatures and Blind Signatures|year=2000|last1=Pointcheval|first1=David|last2=Stern|first2=Jacques|journal=Journal of Cryptology|volume=13|issue=3|pages=361–396|s2cid=1912537}}</ref> the [[Pointcheval-Stern signature algorithm]], and his contributions to [[Password-authenticated key agreement]].<ref>{{Cite web| title=Simple Password-Based Encrypted Key Exchange Protocols | url=https://www.di.ens.fr/~mabdalla/papers/AbPo05a-letter.pdf | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20051016053216/http://www.di.ens.fr/%7Emabdalla/papers/AbPo05a-letter.pdf | archive-date=2005-10-16}}</ref>

==Biography==

An alumnus of the [[École Normale Supérieure]], David Pointcheval obtained his [[Doctor of Philosophy|Ph.D.]] in 1996 from the [[University of Caen Normandy]].
In 1998, he joined the [[French National Centre for Scientific Research]], working within the Computer Science department of [[École Normale Supérieure]].
Since then, his research has focused mostly on [[asymmetric cryptography]] and [[Provable security]], of which he was one of the pioneers.
He has authored more than 100 international publications, and co-invented a dozen patents.
He was awarded a [[European Research Council]] Advanced Grant in 2015.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.di.ens.fr/david.pointcheval/cryptocloud.php|title = ERC - CryptoCloud - CryptAnalytics}}</ref>
In 2021 he received the [[RSA Award for Excellence in Mathematics]].<ref>Archived at [https://ghostarchive.org/varchive/youtube/20211208/exWATDuiDz8 Ghostarchive]{{cbignore}} and the [https://web.archive.org/web/20210518234742/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=exWATDuiDz8 Wayback Machine]{{cbignore}}: {{cite AV media| url = https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=exWATDuiDz8| title = RSA Conference 2021 Award for Excellence in the Field of Mathematics | website=[[YouTube]]}}{{cbignore}}</ref>
